description: This file defines a jQuery plugin for rotating images, including methods for applying rotation, retrieving rotation angles, stopping rotation, and handling cross-browser compatibility especially for older browsers like IE. It involves animation, CSS transforms, and VML fallback for IE.

classes.name: Wilq32.PhotoEffect
classes.description: A constructor function creating an object responsible for applying rotation effects to an image element, with support for CSS transforms and VML fallback.

methods.name: _setupParameters
methods.description: Initializes rotation parameters such as angle, animateTo target, easing, duration, callback, and rotation center based on input.

methods.name: _handleRotation
methods.description: Sets up and executes the rotation, handling immediate rotation or animation if needed, with support for non-supported CSS browsers.

methods.name: _BindEvents
methods.description: Binds specified events to the image or container element.

methods.name: _Loader
methods.description: Loads the image into a VML element for IE or a canvas for modern browsers, preparing the element for rotation.

methods.name: _animate
methods.description: Performs the animation of rotation over time, respecting easing and callback parameters.

methods.name: _rotate
methods.description: Applies the rotation transform to the element, using CSS transforms or canvas drawing, depending on browser support.
